analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today's RSI rose from 45.4 to 53.4 but remains in neutral consolidation, and ADX increased from 11.2 to 13.5 but continues to show no trend. Price bounced with a +2.39% daily move but met resistance near the Bollinger Band middle line. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of directional conviction.
